changeSet.comment: A waiting review job's hold moves to its run. Only a queued run waits, so the hold of a job whose run already left the queue ends with the move.
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE agent_run DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_hold_queued; ALTER TABLE agent_run DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_hold_reason;
